source: Derived 2026-10-31 (#418). Classes and skills are the shared Quest ruleset taken from the Star Quest dataset at its GENERIC naming (Army Forge records each class twice: 'Soldier' for Star Quest, 'Fighter' for AoF: Quest - the second is this file's 'name', the first is kept as 'sqName'). Status conditions are typed from 'AoFQ - Core Rules v2.0.1.pdf' word for word. NOT AVAILABLE: AoF: Quest's shop consumables, its injury table and its level-1 hero stat line all live in the AoF: Quest Campaign Builder, which OPR serves through no API endpoint and which is not among the project's books - so 'consumables' and 'injuries' are deliberately EMPTY rather than guessed, and 'baseHero' is carried over from Star Quest and marked as carried. Add the AoFQ Campaign Builder PDF and these three can be done properly.

notes.whyIdsMatchStarQuest: The class ids are the link between a class and its skills, and between a saved hero and its class. They are deliberately the same values the Star Quest dataset uses, because the two systems share one skill list - a hero's ClassId therefore resolves in either dataset.

baseHero.note: CARRIED OVER from Star Quest, not read from an AoF: Quest book. The level-1 hero stat line lives in the Campaign Builder, which is not available - see 'source'. Both systems are the same Quest ruleset, so this is very likely right, but it is unverified.

conditions.description: When activated, must pass a Dex test to remove status. Crippled models halve their movement distance.

conditions.name: Diseased
conditions.description: When activated, must pass a Wil test to remove status. Diseased models take as many wounds as power they spend.

conditions.name: Impaired
conditions.description: When activated, may spend D3 power to remove status. Impaired models get -1 to all stat rolls.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description: Martial artists relying on the power of their own bodies to produce impressive results.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: Keepers of arcane secrets and forgotten knowledge, that manipulate spells with cunning.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: Stealthy operators that have a knack for picking out enemy weaknesses and exploiting them.

classes.name: Barbarian
classes.description: Relentless combatants that love to get stuck in conflict, fueled by their rage and fury.

classes.name: Bard
classes.description: Public speakers and performers using their wits, spells, and lore to overcome difficult situations.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: Warriors that bolster their efforts with steadfast dedication, gaining special boons and strength through devotion.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: Skilled combatants that rely on their heavy armor and weapons to cut down their enemies.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: Deadly hunters that use a unique blend of wilderness knowledge and martial abilities.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.description: Spell casters that draw their powers from within, channeling their innate powers through themselves and their instruments.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: Nomads devoted to the powers of the natural world, capable of adopting the form of beasts for battle or utility.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.description: Dark spell casters which form pacts with powerful entities they trade favors with for boons and spells.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: Devotees of their deity, capable of bolstering their party and heal their wounds, or laying low their enemies with divine wrath.

classes.name: Default Skills
classes.description: Here are all the default skills which are available to all classes.
